A21:
**Table A21.** Online budget on heterogeneous shards of the chronological streams (CSE-CIC-IDS2018, LightGBM, weighted Fisher priority, 1% budget). The shards are replayed in their merged arrival order within one process. Each shard has its own warm-up threshold and online update unless the threshold is shared; the shared batched threshold is updated after every 4,096 flows of the merged stream, the other shared threshold after every 256 flows with the same per-flow step. With budgets from the warm-up share, one warm-up threshold is taken over the merged stream, each shard's budget is the share of its own warm-up flows above it, and each shard then runs its own update with that budget. With the coordinator, each shard flags a batch with the threshold it received after its own previous batch and sends its excess to one shared threshold, with the step divided by the number of shards (Section 4.11). Load is the queue size divided by the budget; shard loads give the lowest and highest shard over all seeds. Recall, precision and load are measured after the warm-up windows; because attacks cluster in time, the attack share of that part of the stream (last column, precision × load × budget / recall, mean over seeds) differs from the 1% of the whole stream, which is why precision and recall do not match as they would at 1% prevalence.
